name: Firefox Publisher

access.transactions: Not available. Projects start through the contact form or by email; scope and pricing are confirmed individually.

entries.description: Fiction, nonfiction, ghostwriting, memoir and children's book writing.

entries.name: Book Editing
entries.description: Developmental editing, line editing, copyediting and proofreading.

entries.name: Ebook Publishing
entries.description: Formatting, cover and interior preparation, platform setup and upload support.

entries.name: Ebook Publishing Services & Support

entries.name: Book Printing (print-ready files)

entries.name: Book Marketing
entries.description: Launch marketing, social media content, author branding and strategy for ebooks.

entries.name: Author Branding & Illustration
